item.coloph: ces dbal phur nag po'i gnas 'dren lag len snang gsal sgron me zhes bya ba 'di ni dbal phur bon la blo kha phyogs pa tshwa tshwa bla ma tshul khrims bstan dbang rin po ches lha rdzas dri med mtshams sbyar te gsung gis bskul ngor/ g.yung drung slob dpon tsha rong ga shel sher dbang bdag gis gnas chen gnam mtsho'i nye 'dabs skras pa ra ba'i yul gru lha lung du brtsam pa'i dge des snang ston rin po che'i bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig/
